## Privacy and accessibility checklist

- [ ] No new personal data, or `docs/compliance/` (data map, records, retention) is updated in this PR
- [ ] No new third-party runtime request (fonts, scripts, models, APIs), or it is documented and justified
- [ ] No data leaves the device without a visible user action and notice
- [ ] Errors are surfaced to the user; no silent fallback or default value
- [ ] AI output is labeled and stored with its provenance
- [ ] UI changes: keyboard reachable, visible focus, labels, `lang` on Chinese and pinyin, contrast per `docs/design/DESIGN-SYSTEM.md`, axe checks pass
- [ ] Non-pointer, non-speech and untimed alternatives kept for drawing, microphone and timed features
